hero.title: Backend Developer
hero.description: Backend Developer specialized in robust APIs with Java and Spring Boot. Experience in concurrency, automation, and clean architecture.

paragraphs.p1: I am a backend developer with a focus on Java and Spring Boot, specialized in designing and building robust, scalable, and maintainable APIs.
paragraphs.p2: I have complementary experience in Python using frameworks such as FastAPI and Quart, which allows me to adapt to different environments and development needs. Additionally, I work with process automation through GitHub Actions and apply testing to ensure the quality and reliability of applications.
paragraphs.p3: I focus on writing clean code, applying best practices, and building solutions aimed at efficiently solving real problems.

lumu.description: I developed and maintained REST APIs in Python using the Quart framework, following clean code principles and technical documentation standards. I contributed to the frontend development of internal applications using React, TypeScript, and Material UI (MUI), implementing reusable components and functional improvements. I collaborated in agile workflows using Git, Bitbucket, Jira, and Confluence under Scrum methodology, supporting system maintenance, continuous improvement, and delivering enhancements that optimized engineering team processes.
